notes.title: 🎉 GIRL.EXE.EXE IS OUT!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back to the mansion of broken rooms, repeating paths, and a voice you haven’t heard in a while.
It’s over now. Or maybe... it’s just beginning.[/p][p]Go through the 5 stages of grief, find bugs, fix them — or end up in punishment rooms.
Piece yourself together. Maybe then she’ll let you go.
Or maybe… she’ll stay forever.[/p][p]🐶 You’ll have a little dog to keep you company.
🎹 And her voice is already inside.[/p][p]Thank you for waiting.
The game is now fully released.[/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_RU"]t.me/Dymchick1_RU[/url][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_EN"]t.me/Dymchick1_EN[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🇬🇧 DEVELOPMENT UPDATE — GIRL.EXE.EXE
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The last month has been intense — I’ve fixed a ton of bugs, polished the experience, and gotten much closer to the final version of the game.
GIRL.EXE.EXE has grown into something much bigger than I originally imagined. And now, I'm almost ready to let it go.[/p][p]💀 This is nearly the release build. If everything goes well, the full version will be out in about 10 days.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and shared your feedback — it’s been incredibly helpful in finishing the game the right way.
If you haven’t played the demo yet — now’s a perfect time to check it out.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with me for these 3 years. The finale is coming very soon.[/p][p]— Dymchick1[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_RU"]t.me/Dymchick1_RU[/url][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_EN"]t.me/Dymchick1_EN[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Steam Next Fest starts today!
notes.content:
[p]If you have some time — I’d love for you to try the demo and share your feedback.
Please keep in mind: I’m still actively fixing bugs, so please be gentle. Every bit of feedback helps a lot![/p][p]To help you understand how the game works, I made a short video explaining the rules:
👉 find differences in the rooms
👉 if there’s a difference — go back and fix the bug on your computer
👉 if not — move forward
👉 if you make a mistake — you’ll enter a punishment room
👉 if you fail the punishment — stress/madness will build up
👉 complete all 5 chapters and save the game![/p][p]Thank you all for your support ❤️
I hope you enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_EN"]t.me/Dymchick1_EN[/url][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_RU"]t.me/Dymchick1_RU[/url][/p]

🎮 The demo of GIRL.EXE.EXE is now live on Steam!

The demo version of my game GIRL.EXE.EXE is finally out!
Dive into a mysterious, broken world of an unfinished game. Fix bugs, read strange notes, explore glitchy rooms — and maybe, just maybe, understand why this game still haunts you.

notes.title: Steam approved the game
notes.content:
Good news!
Steam has approved the game build! 🤩 Now I have that tempting Release App button.
That means I can launch the game at any moment. 😊

Hehe. If you’d like to play early and share some detailed feedback — feel free to message me here or in DMs. I’d really appreciate your thoughts! 🎮💬

notes.title: Development Update – Progress, Achievements & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Dymchick1 here! 🚀

Development of GIRL.EXE.EXE is in full swing! I’ve been working hard, and here’s what’s new:
✔️ Achievements added – now you’ll have more challenges to complete!
✔️ Full translation – the game page is now available in multiple languages.
✔️ Updated Steam page – added cool GIFs and improved the overall look.

The game is still in development, but if someone REALLY wants to test it, I’m open to it. Just keep in mind – it’s still a work in progress!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for your support! 💜
